title: Yellowed Smoky Slovakian Ackee Pilaf
description: Savory and silky Slovakian dish featuring ackee, binchotan-charcoal, and seafood, perfect for festive occasions. This pescatarian-friendly pilaf is a unique blend of flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: ackee
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, drained and chopped

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 5 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and stir to combine with the shrimp and onion mixture.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped ackee and stir to combine.
Add the binchotan charcoal powder and stir to combine, cooking for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
